title: Bross & Winspace Bike Shop in Tianjin, China - Superbikes at Affordable Prices

takeaways.text: The presenter describes an M40/M60 carbon lay-up, which differs from the T800/T1100/M46/M65 specification another reviewer reports; neither is independently verified here.
In a Tianjin dealer in June 2026 the M6 complete bike with Shimano 105 Di2, Hyper aero cockpit and UNAS carbon wheels was CNY 16,900.
That shop build weighed 7.8 kg on the shop scale; frame size and pedal fitment were not stated.

disclosure: The channel page lists Lameda and Light Bicycle as partners with discount codes; no model-specific supply statement was established for this video.
summary: Tianjin shop-tour context that explicitly lists the Winspace M6. It does not select the exact trim behind the retained mainland price observation or establish current specifications.
